nina_csm: Hey team — quick recap from onboarding calls this week. I captured a few recurring asks and two blockers that could impact renewals if we don’t address them soon. Need product + dev input for prioritization this sprint.

maria_cs: Short bullets from customers: 1) per-route tagging for embeddings (so they can split spend by product) 2) CSV export of onboarding metrics (time-to-first-success, error rates) 3) clearer cost breakdown in Console by route/model.

jamie_prod: Thanks. Which ask has the highest renewal risk?

nina_csm: Per-route cost visibility is the highest risk — two mid-market renewals paused quoting pending it. CSV export is more of an enablement friction (sales ops needs it). Tagging is high impact for customers doing multi-tenant routing.

aj_devex: Can you paste one example of the CSV columns they want? I can sketch a quick export endpoint.

nina_csm: Example schema they sketched: `customer_id, route_name, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_estimate, timestamp, user_events_count` — they also want filters by date and route.

sam_engineer: Per-route tagging for embeddings sounds like schema + runtime routing changes. Implementation questions: is this a metadata tag on embeddings or a route-level attribute?

maria_cs: They expect route-level tag that flows through embedding generation and is persisted on the vector store index entries.

sam_engineer: Ok. That narrows it. Estimated 3-4 dev days for tagging + 2 days for console display. CSV export 1-2 dev days if we reuse existing metrics pipeline.

jamie_prod: Prioritization suggestion: (A) cost visibility by route — MVP in console + export, (B) CSV export for onboarding metrics, (C) per-route embedding tag as follow-up. Anyone disagree? :thinking_face:

aj_devex: +1 to that order. For the console MVP, can we show a per-route toggle under Usage -> Routes and a download button?

nina_csm: That would satisfy the immediate sales ask. Also request from customers: notify CSMs when route spend crosses thresholds. Could add later as an alerting follow-up.

opsbot: Deploy note: spike branch for per-route-cost-view created at `git#feature/route-cost-view`. CI passed.

sam_engineer: Good. I'll pick up the UI work and the backend endpoint. aj_devex — can you own the CSV export schema and example webhook?

aj_devex: Yup — I'll draft a spec by EOD tomorrow and link it here.

maria_cs: Thanks all. I'll update the renewal playbook and flag the two deals. Will follow up with sample CSV from customer for validation. :thumbsup:
